## PodcastOne (Nasdaq: PODC) to Report Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results on November 12, 2026


11/11/2026


Download (opens in new window)


Management to host conference call and webcast to discuss the results at 12:30 pm ET on that day


**LOS ANGELES, CA /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / November 11, 2026 /** PodcastOne (Nasdaq:[PODC](https://pr.report/tfkq) ), a leading publisher and podcast sales network, announced today the planned earnings release date and conference call timing for its second quarter ("Q2 Fiscal 2027") of its fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 ("Fiscal 2027").


PodcastOne plans to announce its full operating and financial results for Q2 Fiscal 2027 and host an investor webcast to discuss the results and provide a business update on Thursday, November 12th, 2026 at 12:30 pm Eastern Time (9:30 am Pacific Time).


To access the conference call or webcast, please use the following information:


Date: Thursday, November 12, 2026


Time: 12:30 pm ET (9:30 am PT)


Webcast Link:[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/272989708](https://pr.report/tfkr)


Dial-in: (833) 461-5787


International Dial-in: (585) 542-9983


Conference Code: 272 989 708


**About PodcastOne, Inc.**


[PodcastOne](https://pr.report/tfks) (NASDAQ:PODC) is a leading podcast platform that provides creators and advertisers with a comprehensive 360-degree solution in sales, marketing, public relations, production, and distribution. PodcastOne has surpassed 3.9 billion total downloads with a community of 200 top podcasters, including Adam Carolla, Kaitlyn Bristowe, Jordan Harbinger, LadyGang, A&E's Cold Case Files, and Varnamtown. PodcastOne has built a distribution network reaching over 1 billion monthly impressions across all channels, including YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and iHeartRadio. PodcastOne is also the parent company of[PodcastOne Pro](https://pr.report/tfkt) which offers fully customizable production packages for brands, professionals, or hobbyists. For more information, visit[www.podcastone.com](https://pr.report/tfku) and follow us on[Facebook](https://pr.report/tfkv) ,[Instagram](https://pr.report/tfkw) ,[YouTube](https://pr.report/tfkx) , and[X](https://pr.report/tfky) at @podcastone.
